title: An Introductory Primer and Grammar of Ahom Tai Language
author: Dr. J. N. Phukan & Prof. B. K. Barua
description: Pedagogical grammar and syllabary of the Tai language of Assam, providing comparative phonetic tables of consonants, vowels, and tone boxes across Ahom, Khamti, and Khamyang. Details nominal classifiers, demonstratives, and aspectual verbal markers.
